name: @pipeworx/mcp-httpstatus

tools.name: http_status
tools.description: Look up an HTTP status code (100-599): its reason phrase, category, and meaning. Keyless, offline.

tools.name: list_http_statuses
tools.description: List HTTP status codes, optionally filtered to a class (1, 2, 3, 4 or 5 for 1xx…5xx).

class.description: Optional leading digit 1-5 to filter (e.g. 4 for 4xx).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-httpstatus forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the httpstatus pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
